summary: A primary action paired with a button that opens a menu of related secondary actions. Two real buttons in a named group.
whenToUse: A default action with variants (Save / Save as copy, Send / Schedule send).
whenNotToUse: Unrelated actions: use separate buttons or a DropdownMenu.
When there is no obvious default action: use DropdownMenu alone.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called with the id of the chosen item.

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the menu button.

props.name: isPending
props.description: Spinner on the primary action; the menu stays available.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Decorative icon for the primary action.

props.name: type
props.description: Type of the primary button (submit inside a form).

inherits: className, id, and aria-label on the group (role="group"; default name: the label, if it is text).

keyboard.action: Reaches the primary action first, then the menu button.
On the menu button: opens the menu.
Closes the menu and returns focus to the menu button.

accessibility: The menu button has aria-haspopup and aria-expanded; the menu follows the APG Menu Button pattern.
Dangerous items (tone="danger") must also be understandable from their text.
responsive: The menu button keeps the minimum target size; the menu never exceeds the viewport width.
customization: [data-variant] selector on the group; items accept MenuItem's icon, tone, and shortcut.
commonMistakes: Leaving the menu button without a name when you change the language: pass menuLabel or use messages.
Duplicating the primary action inside the menu.
